title: Look at the Seguin Computer Science Club!
content:
Its the computer science team at my school! (Well, except for Vincent) These guys are the best! Just wanted to show them off.

![the team](./assets/20261112_152854.jpg)

**Me**- Bottom Left

**Zak**- Above me, not really the best at computer science but he can light up the room!

**Henry**- Above Zak, pretty novice with computers but realy good at art and super friendly!

**Xander**- Next to Zak, very close friend, he is very talented and I am always inspired by what he does! he even has his own portfolio website right [here!](https://realprot0n.github.io/)

**Michael**- Above Xander, super smart! He is learning computer science very quickly, I am very invested in his journey! He impresses in everything he does.

**Mr. Schramm**- Top right corner, he's kinda just been along for the ride, but he's been a very good sponsor and coach!

**Vincent**- Not here, he's only recently found out that he wants to do web development with his life and he's been making great progress! He's also very cool to talk and play games with.

So yeah, thats the club! They are all very great and I couldn't have wished for a better team to have!

-Withered Detective

title: I have made a blog!
content:
Isn't this so totally tubular? I spent a few hours on this. I hope I can make this something great! Feel free to leave a comment here.

In other news, the seguin comp sci team and I are doing the nasa space apps challenge saturday! We are also doing the Godot Wild Jam 99 this next week. Now that my eagle project is done, I can't wait to get back into the swing of things.

Check out my other projects too! look up to the tabs on the top of this page.

-Withered Detective
